data.long_meaning: From the Greek name Kleon, meaning 'glorifier' or 'renowned one'. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Cleon usually hope their child will grow to embody glorifier of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
